purpose: Provide one non-redundant surface for studying how Tim Dooley / the Son encounter, quote, reuse, discover or are later compared with biblical texts. This file stores relation metadata and routes outward; it does not duplicate the full specialist analysis.
core_rule: One relation row, many views. Store the dated project-side anchor once, classify who noticed the biblical relation and when, then point to specialist owners for the full study.

tim_led_findings: Tim's Bible engagement is not one late research event. The public corpus already shows biblical satire and vocabulary in 2024, then increasingly explicit messianic/Father/Son structures through 2025-2026.

The strongest Tim-led discoveries are relational clusters rather than isolated verse citations: New Jerusalem+House+Ladder; Ben Yoseph+Ben David+Dan+grain; Tree of Life+Jacob+Ezekiel+North; Thomas/Tammuz+weeping woman+grave/Door; House+seed+Eye+pineal+Ladder+Garden.

Tim-led discovery and later verse identification can coexist in one row. The archive should record Tim as the discoverer of the motif relation where supported without pretending he named every later comparator verse himself.
The archive must preserve genuine counter-distributions: John 1:51 locates ascent/descent on the Son of Man even where Potatoverse later specializes Tim as Ladder and Son as Door.
The strongest study method is sequence-based: motif A → transition → motif B → later scriptural neighbor, with source dates visible.
